title: dmhd6219 Server
description: A Fabric-based Vanilla Enhanced server-side modpack for Minecraft 1.21.8, focused on performance, quality-of-life improvements, and immersive multiplayer features — without changing core vanilla gameplay.
body:
# Vanilla Enhanced Server Modpack (Fabric)

This project is a **server-side Vanilla Enhanced modpack** for **Minecraft 1.21.8 (Fabric)**, designed to improve performance, stability, and multiplayer experience while staying true to vanilla mechanics.

## ✨ What does this modpack add?

### 🚀 Performance & Optimization
This modpack focuses heavily on server performance and stability, especially for long-running multiplayer worlds.

Included optimizations:
- **Lithium** – major server-side logic optimizations  
- **FerriteCore** – reduced memory usage  
- **Krypton** – faster networking  
- **ModernFix** – memory, startup, and bug fixes  
- **C2ME (Concurrent Chunk Management Engine)** – faster chunk generation and loading  
- **Alternate Current** – optimized redstone  
- **ServerCore** – improved server tick handling  

## 🧰 Quality of Life Improvements
Carefully selected vanilla-friendly QoL features that do not alter core gameplay:

- AppleSkin  
- Better Statistics Screen  
- Easy Anvils / Easy Magic  
- Easy Shulker Boxes  
- Trade Cycling  
- Armor Statues & Armor Stand Arms  
- Invisible & Waxable Item Frames  
- Visual Workbench  
- Pick Up Notifier  
- Horse Expert / Horseman  

## 🗣 Multiplayer & Social Features
Enhancements for player interaction and communication:

- **Simple Voice Chat**  
  - Voice Chat Interaction  
  - Simple Voice Chat Radio  
  - Voice Messages  
- Styled Chat & Advanced Chat  
- Styled Player List  
- Emotecraft  
- Sit  
- Telegram server integration  

## 🛠 Administration & Maintenance
Tools for server owners and administrators:

- **spark** – performance profiling  
- **Dynmap** – live server map  
- Backup Mod – automated backups  
- Debugify – vanilla bug fixes  
- safeserver – additional server protection  
- Packet Fixer – network stability improvements  

## 📦 Server-Side Only
- **No client-side mods required**
- Vanilla clients can join without installing anything
- No custom blocks, items, or gameplay overhauls

## 🎯 Who is this modpack for?
- Server owners who want a **stable and optimized vanilla server**
- Multiplayer communities focused on **performance and quality of life**
- Players who prefer **vanilla gameplay with modern improvements**

This modpack aims to feel like **Minecraft — but smoother, more stable, and more comfortable for multiplayer**.
